cat-cotton-100.label: 100% Cotton
cat-cotton-100.source: MADE-BY Benchmark 2019 + Textile Exchange Fiber Report 2022 — conventional cotton cradle-to-gate

cat-cotton-organic.label: Organic Cotton
cat-cotton-organic.source: Textile Exchange Organic Cotton LCA 2022 — organic cotton cradle-to-gate

cat-cotton-recycled.label: Recycled Cotton
cat-cotton-recycled.source: Textile Exchange Recycled Cotton LCA 2022 — mechanically recycled

cat-polyester-100.label: 100% Polyester
cat-polyester-100.source: MADE-BY Benchmark 2019 + Ecoinvent 3.10 — virgin PET fiber cradle-to-gate

cat-polyester-recycled.label: Recycled Polyester (rPET)
cat-polyester-recycled.source: Textile Exchange rPET LCA 2022 — bottle-to-fiber recycled polyester

cat-wool-100.label: 100% Wool
cat-wool-100.source: Textile Exchange Fiber Report 2022 + MADE-BY Benchmark — conventional wool, includes enteric fermentation (CH₄). Range 20–36 kgCO₂e/kg.

cat-wool-merino.label: Merino Wool
cat-wool-merino.source: Textile Exchange Fiber Report 2022 — merino wool NZ/AUS origin, includes enteric fermentation. Range 20–35 kgCO₂e/kg.

cat-silk-100.label: 100% Silk
cat-silk-100.source: Wang et al. (2021) LCA of silk production, China origin + Ecoinvent 3.10. Includes mulberry cultivation and reeling. Range 10–70 kgCO₂e/kg.

cat-bamboo.label: Bamboo Fabric
cat-bamboo.source: Textile Exchange Fiber Report 2022 — bamboo viscose/lyocell (chemical process); cradle-to-gate

cat-hemp.label: Hemp Fabric
cat-hemp.source: Textile Exchange 2022 — mechanically processed hemp fiber, cradle-to-gate

cat-tencel.label: Tencel/Lyocell
cat-tencel.source: Lenzing AG Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) 2022 — TENCEL™ Lyocell closed-loop

cat-leather-genuine.label: Genuine Leather
cat-leather-genuine.source: FAO/UNEP 2021 co-product allocation (economic) — bovine leather, tanning included. Range 15–20 kgCO₂e/kg with economic allocation.

cat-leather-faux.label: Faux Leather/PU
cat-leather-faux.source: Ecoinvent 3.10 — polyurethane coated fabric (PU faux leather)

cat-down.label: Down Feather
cat-down.source: Higg MSI 2023 — down feather (waterfowl), co-product allocation. Range 18–30 kgCO₂e/kg.

cat-faux-fur.label: Faux Fur
cat-faux-fur.source: WeaveCarbon proxy — acrylic-based faux fur, aligned with acrylic fiber LCA

energy-wind-generic.label: Generic onshore wind electricity
energy-wind-generic.source: IPCC AR6 WG3 Ch.6 lifecycle GHG — onshore wind median

energy-coal-generic.label: Coal-fired electricity generation
energy-coal-generic.source: IEA Emissions Factors 2023 — subcritical coal power average

energy-gas-generic.label: Natural gas electricity (CCGT)

energy-mixed-generic.label: Generic mixed energy (global average)
energy-mixed-generic.source: IEA 2023 world average grid emission intensity

process-knitting.label: Knitting process — electrical intensity
process-knitting.source: SAC Higg FEM benchmarks + European BREF Textile BAT 2017 — knitting stage

process-weaving.label: Weaving process — electrical intensity

process-dyeing.label: Wet dyeing — total energy intensity (electrical equiv.)
process-dyeing.source: European BREF Textile BAT 2017 + SAC Higg FEM — wet processing (dyeing). Includes thermal energy equivalent. Range 4–10 kWh/kg.

process-printing.label: Printing process — total energy intensity
process-printing.source: SAC Higg FEM benchmarks — digital & screen printing

process-finishing.label: Finishing process — total energy intensity
